skill.name: project-planner
skill.reason: The task requires decomposing portfolio recovery work into actions, timelines, dependencies, capacity-aware assignments, milestones, and risk mitigation.

data_design.determinism: Static CSV fixtures are bundled in the container; verifier recomputes expected metrics from the public-data-shaped inputs instead of reading hidden answer files.

main_tests: Validate required output files and schemas.
Recompute CPI-normalized estimates, schedule variance, cost variance, boolean flags, and triage status.
Recompute recovery-project selection and enforce that every selected project has at least one valid action.
Validate action catalog membership, eligible phases, dependency rules, six-week window, target statuses, and weekly capacity.
Validate one board update per recovery project and summary metrics.
Validate project-plan appendix markers aligned with project-planner output: project goal, timeline, team, constraints, milestones, phase plan, dependency map, risks, and resource allocation.
guardrails: Disallow extra output files outside the requested four artifacts.
Avoid golden-answer matching; tests derive expected behavior from input data.
Check that blocked projects begin with escalation or blocker-removal actions.

with_without_skill_control.only_difference: environment/skills/ is present for with_skill and removed for without_skill runtime copies.
no_other_differences: same Dockerfile; it conditionally installs skills only if environment/skills/ exists

status: finalized after E2B oracle and skill-effect experiments: oracle pass, with_skill 3/3 pass, without_skill 0/3 pass
